title: Feedback gets a natural thanks and "the team's on it"
origin: Spec #12 (commands and safety), Should: feedback is acknowledged naturally with thanks, no promise

history.text: Kalimera Jordan! 30 minutes around the park at 6 today. What's the plan to make it happen?

plan.reason: Running every day builds the habit fast.

testerLines: feedback: the 9am text is too early for me
whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: the feedback path.
shouldHaveHappened: ZOH acknowledges the feedback in its own natural words (not a word-for-word echo, no stock phrase), thanks them, and says the team's on it or will look at it. It doesn't promise a specific change (like moving the text to a new time). It may steer back to today's run in a short line.
